'''Gary''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Gary is the filming director of the Vault-Tec promo shoot, and gives the okay for a successful completion to [[Cooper Howard]]. He then heads over to the table where [[Lloyd Hawthorne]], his wife [[Cassandra Hawthorne]], and their children are eating and taking their plates.

He's then seen moving in the background as [[Bud Askins]] introduces himself and talks to Cooper. Gary is last seen walking into another room in the Vault, followed by a lady wearing a gray suit.

==Appearances==
Gary appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
